XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the Course Sync block

TABLE.NAME: block_coursesync_connection
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per configured block instance: where the remote site is, the encrypted token used to reach it, and the outcome of the last connection test.

FIELD.NAME: blockinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The block instance this connection belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised course id of the block instance, for reporting.

FIELD.NAME: remoteurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Base URL of the remote source site, always https.

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Web service token for the remote site, encrypted with core\encryption. Never stored in plain text.

FIELD.NAME: tokenhint
FIELD.COMMENT: Last few characters of the token, shown in the UI so an admin can tell which token is stored.

FIELD.NAME: remotesitename
FIELD.COMMENT: Site name reported by the remote site at the last successful ping.

FIELD.NAME: remoterelease
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle release reported by the remote site at the last successful ping.

FIELD.NAME: remotecourseref
FIELD.COMMENT: What the administrator typed to identify the remote course: either a numeric id or a shortname.

FIELD.NAME: remotecourseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Numeric course id on the remote site, resolved from remotecourseref when the mapping was saved.

FIELD.NAME: remotecourseshortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Shortname of the mapped remote course, for display.

FIELD.NAME: remotecoursename
FIELD.COMMENT: Full name of the mapped remote course, for display.

FIELD.NAME: setupstage
FIELD.COMMENT: How far through the setup wizard this connection has got: url, token or tested.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Outcome of the last connection test: new, ok or error.

FIELD.NAME: lasterror
FIELD.COMMENT: Error identifier from the last failed test, used to look up a translated message.

FIELD.NAME: lastcheck
FIELD.COMMENT: Time of the last connection test.

FIELD.NAME: lastsync
FIELD.COMMENT: When activities were last actually pulled from the remote course. Null means never. Phase 3 only reads this; it is written from phase 4 onwards, once there is a real sync to record.

TABLE.NAME: block_coursesync_run
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per sync run: when it happened, who started it, what it pulled, and what it flagged for review.

FIELD.NAME: blockinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The block instance the run belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The destination course.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who started the run.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: What the run pulled: activities, or grades.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: ok when everything asked for was pulled, review when something was flagged, failed when the run could not finish.

FIELD.NAME: errorkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Why a failed run failed, as a language string identifier.

FIELD.NAME: since
FIELD.COMMENT: The point in time the run asked the source about.

FIELD.NAME: lastsyncmoved
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the run moved the last synced marker forward.

FIELD.NAME: pulled
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of the activities created by this run.

FIELD.NAME: conflicts
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of the activities flagged for manual review.

FIELD.NAME: others
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of everything else the run considered: skipped and failed activities.

TABLE.NAME: block_coursesync_grade
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per grade a grade pull wrote: what it wrote, so a later pull can tell a grade it may update from one somebody here has since changed.

FIELD.NAME: blockinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The block instance whose pull wrote the grade.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The destination course.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student the grade belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: gradeitemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The grade item here the grade was written to.

FIELD.NAME: remotecmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id of the original activity on the source site.

FIELD.NAME: itemnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Which of the activity's grade items.

FIELD.NAME: finalgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: The grade as written, null for feedback only.

FIELD.NAME: feedbackhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the feedback as written. The feedback itself is not kept twice.

FIELD.NAME: remotetime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the grade last changed on the source site.
